$description: Soty Purple & Honey design tokens. DTCG-compatible JSON for Tokens Studio.

purple.$description: Brand scale. Purple communicates Soty, structure, navigation, selection and focus; it is not the primary action color.

50.$description: Barely visible purple tint for page decoration and very subtle backgrounds.

100.$description: Selected backgrounds, icon containers and secondary button surfaces in light theme.

200.$description: Soft brand borders, separators and inactive honeycomb outlines.

300.$description: Dark-theme focus ring and low-emphasis purple highlight.

400.$description: Dark-theme hover state and bright brand detail.

500.$description: General illustrations, icons and medium-emphasis brand graphics.

600.$description: Primary Soty brand color in light theme.

700.$description: Light-theme hover state for purple controls and links.

800.$description: Pressed state and deep section of a light-theme purple surface.

900.$description: Large branded surfaces and featured cards in dark theme.

950.$description: Deepest purple for dark gradients, overlays and secondary dark surfaces.

honey.$description: Action and honey-material scale. Honey is reserved for primary actions, progress and small tactile brand details.

50.$description: Very subtle action background or honey-tinted empty state.

100.$description: Honey specular highlight and soft warning/action background.

300.$description: Bright honey highlight; use sparingly in material illustrations.

400.$description: Primary CTA and active state in dark theme.

500.$description: Primary CTA and action color in light theme.

600.$description: Hover state for light-theme CTA and depth inside honey.

800.$description: Internal honey shadow; not for ordinary UI text.

950.$description: Readable foreground text on honey buttons.

neutral.$description: Purple-tinted neutral scale for backgrounds, surfaces, typography, borders and disabled states.

0.$description: Primary white card surface and inverse text.

100.$description: Disabled light surface and quiet separators.

300.$description: Strong light-theme border and control outline.

700.$description: High-emphasis secondary text or dark outline.

800.$description: Dark neutral surface and light-theme primary text support.

900.$description: Deep elevated surface in dark compositions.

950.$description: Default dark-theme page background; use instead of pure black.

light.$description: Semantic color roles for the Soty light theme. Components should reference these roles instead of primitive colors whenever possible.

background.$description: Page and component surfaces. Page is the canvas; surface is a standard card; elevated is used for popovers and raised content.

text.$description: Typography roles. Primary is for titles and essential content; secondary for descriptions; muted only for nonessential metadata.

border.$description: Structural lines. Default separates cards; strong outlines focused or emphasized controls; brand marks purple structure.

brand.$description: Purple interaction roles. Use for identity, selection, focus, links and secondary actions, never as the main CTA color.

action.$description: Honey action roles. Reserved for primary CTA, progress and the current action; do not use across ordinary decoration.

disabled.$description: Noninteractive light-theme state. Disabled controls must also communicate their state through opacity, label or icon.

status.$description: Strict three-color status mapping: purple means ready, honey means active, neutral means in development. Always pair color with text or an icon.

dark.$description: Semantic color roles for the Soty dark theme. Accent colors are intentionally lighter than their light-theme equivalents for contrast.

background.$description: Dark page and component surfaces with a purple undertone; never replace the page background with pure black.

text.$description: Dark-theme typography roles. Muted text is for nonessential information only and must remain readable on its actual surface.

border.$description: Dark-theme structural borders. Prefer subtle separation over bright outlines or glow.

brand.$description: Dark-theme purple roles for identity, selection, focus, links and secondary actions.

action.$description: Dark-theme honey roles for primary CTA, progress and active work. Honey 400 is brighter to remain visible on dark surfaces.

disabled.$description: Noninteractive dark-theme state. Do not use honey or bright purple on disabled controls.

status.$description: Dark-theme status mapping: light purple means ready, honey means active, neutral means in development. Never rely on color alone.

light.$description: Ready-to-apply component tokens for the Soty light theme.

logo.$description: Honey mark plus purple wordmark. Use the neutral inverse wordmark only on dark or purple surfaces.

buttonPrimary.$description: Highest-emphasis action such as ‘Відкрити’. Use no more than one primary action per card or local action group.

buttonSecondary.$description: Lower-emphasis action, filter or supporting navigation. It must not compete with the honey primary CTA.

toolCard.$description: Standard scalable tool card. The whole card may be a direct link; title, description, status and CTA keep consistent positions.

teamCard.$description: Featured full-width Team space card. This is the largest purple brand surface; keep honey limited to its CTA and one small material detail.

dark.$description: Ready-to-apply component tokens for the Soty dark theme.

logo.$description: Honey mark with light neutral wordmark for the dark header.

buttonPrimary.$description: Dark-theme highest-emphasis action. Use solid honey without neon glow.

buttonSecondary.$description: Dark-theme lower-emphasis action using a subtle purple surface.

toolCard.$description: Standard dark tool card. Use thin neutral borders and purple icon containers; avoid colored glowing outlines.

teamCard.$description: Featured Team space card in deep purple. Honey remains limited to the CTA and a restrained honey detail.

honeyMaterial.$description: Five-step material recipe for rendered honey. Use only in brand illustration or tiny tactile details, not as general UI fills.

guidance.$description: Human-readable usage rules included with the token package.

proportion.$description: Default color distribution for a balanced screen. Honey stays scarce so actions remain obvious.

purpleRole.$description: Use purple for the Soty identity, icon containers, navigation, selected states, focus rings and large branded surfaces.

honeyRole.$value: Primary action, progress and honey material
honeyRole.$description: Use honey for the main CTA, active progress and small tactile honey details. Do not use it for ordinary borders or all icons.

neutralRole.$value: Canvas, surfaces, text, borders and disabled states
neutralRole.$description: Use purple-tinted neutrals instead of pure black or cold gray so both themes remain visually related.

primaryAction.$value: One honey CTA per card or local action group
primaryAction.$description: The visible honey action and the clickable card may lead to the same destination; never add an intermediate selection click.

statusRule.$value: Ready = purple; active = honey; development = neutral
statusRule.$description: Always pair status color with readable text or an icon so meaning never depends on color alone.

gradientRule.$description: Avoid universal purple-to-orange gradients; they weaken hierarchy and create a generic gaming or AI-template look.

materialRule.$description: Cards and purple surfaces stay matte. Only the honey illustration or tiny honey seam receives realistic gloss and refraction.

accessibilityRule.$value: Use semantic roles and verify contrast in context
accessibilityRule.$description: Do not use muted text for essential content. Use dark text on honey buttons and light text only on sufficiently dark purple surfaces.
